name: omnibox
description: OmniBox - 多功能应用聚合平台 (Featuring Court Ledger)

scripts.d1:migrate: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute host-calculator-db --remote --file=../migrations/0001_create_venues.sql
scripts.d1:migrate:local: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute host-calculator-db --local --file=../migrations/0001_create_venues.sql
scripts.d1:sync:data: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 export host-calculator-db --local --no-schema --output=./dump_data.sql && sed -i '' 's/INSERT INTO/INSERT OR REPLACE INTO/g' ./dump_data.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute host-calculator-db --remote --file=./dump_data.sql && rm ./dump_data.sql
scripts.d1:pull: cd worker && rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npx wrangler d1 export host-calculator-db --remote --output=./dump_remote.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute host-calculator-db --local --file=./dump_remote.sql && rm ./dump_remote.sql
